title: Scroll Parallax
description: Drifts an element as the page scrolls past it, so background layers travel more slowly than foreground ones. Progress comes from scroll position rather than from a clock, so it tracks the user's finger exactly.

params.label: Drift
params.description: Total travel across the scroll range. Negative values move against the scroll, which reads as closer to the viewer.

params.label: Per-layer offset
params.description: Adds this much extra drift to each subsequent target, so a stack of layers separates into depth.
